grade_reason: No statement by JoAnna Mendoza about AI was found in news coverage or on her campaign site since 1 January 2025.
notes: Seven web searches ran; none was refused. None returned a statement by Mendoza about AI. Search hits about AI in Arizona concerned other officials (Rep. Ansari, Sen. Gallego, Attorney General Mayes). The site-restricted search returned nothing from joannamendoza.com, so I opened the campaign site directly: the home page and the national security, jobs and workers, and water/energy/climate issue pages. None mentions AI. The water/energy page says only that 'As new industries like data centers expand, JoAnna will fight to make sure that these industries bring their own energy', which concerns energy and does not mention AI, so it is not recorded as a statement. The Arizona Capitol Times article on the data center debate in campaigns (7 September 2026) does not mention her. As a first-time candidate she has no earlier office record. No source shows her backing the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act. I did not open the other campaign issue pages (costs, healthcare, border, government accountability, veterans).
